mapper.sql:
SELECT m.id, m.scene_code, m.title, m.content_type, m.category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.link_url, m.sender_user_id, r.is_read, r.read_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_user, m.update_user FROM in_app_message_recipient r INNER JOIN in_app_message m ON m.id = r.message_id LEFT JOIN in_app_message_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND m.recipient_scope_type != 'ALL' AND m.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL')
AND r.is_read = #{query.isRead}

SELECT m.id, m.scene_code, m.title, m.content_type, m.category_id, c.name AS category_name, m.link_url, m.sender_user_id, COALESCE(s.is_read, 0) AS is_read, s.read_time, m.create_time, m.update_time, m.create_user, m.update_user FROM in_app_message m LEFT JOIN in_app_message_user_status s ON s.message_id = m.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} LEFT JOIN in_app_message_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.recipient_scope_type = 'ALL' AND m.status = 'SUCCESS' AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_deleted = 0 )
AND s.is_read = 1
AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_read = 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT major.id AS majorCategoryId, major.name AS majorCategoryName, major.code AS majorCategoryCode, COALESCE(unread.unread_count, 0) AS unreadCount FROM in_app_message_category major LEFT JOIN ( SELECT major_category_id, SUM(cnt) AS unread_count FROM ( SELECT c.parent_id AS major_category_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM in_app_message_recipient r INNER JOIN in_app_message m ON m.id = r.message_id INNER JOIN in_app_message_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE r.user_id = #{userId} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.is_read = 0 AND m.recipient_scope_type <> 'ALL' AND m.status IN ('SUCCESS', 'PARTIAL') AND c.parent_id > 0 GROUP BY c.parent_id UNION ALL SELECT c.parent_id AS major_category_id, COUNT(1) AS cnt FROM in_app_message m INNER JOIN in_app_message_category c ON c.id = m.category_id LEFT JOIN in_app_message_user_status s ON s.message_id = m.id AND s.user_id = #{userId} WHERE m.recipient_scope_type = 'ALL' AND m.status = 'SUCCESS' AND c.parent_id > 0 AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_deleted = 0 ) AND ( s.id IS NULL OR s.is_read = 0 ) GROUP BY c.parent_id ) unread_by_major GROUP BY major_category_id ) unread ON unread.major_category_id = major.id WHERE major.parent_id = 0 AND major.status = 1 ORDER BY major.sort_order, major.id
